subject: Post-call: Acme / Redwood pricing & token-volume next steps
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Acme / Redwood pricing & token-volume next steps

Alex — great to speak this morning. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery: 

Summary of what we heard: 
- Primary use: in-product assistant (search + summarization + short-form generation) across web and mobile.
- Expected traffic: rough ballpark you shared of ~25M tokens/month initially, with growth to ~60M over 12 months.
- Target budget: you indicated a monthly procurement budget in the $20k–$35k range (flex depending on committed term).
- Key concerns: predictable unit economics ($/1M tokens), embedding/semantic search cost, and procurement timelines.

Requested items from our side: 
1) Attached draft invoice estimate (acme-token-estimate.xlsx) and a short cost breakdown (acme-cost-breakdown.pdf) — these use the volumes you gave and a couple of commitment scenarios.
2) Clarify profile: can you confirm average prompt + response token lengths (approx avg tokens per request)? We used 300 tokens/request as a starting assumption.
3) Confirm whether embeddings are in-scope for pilot (we included an optional line in the attached sheet).

High-level pricing note (ballpark):
- Uncommitted hosted API: ~ $15–$18 per 1M tokens at the throughput profile we discussed.
- 12-month commit/Reserved capacity + modest commitment discount: target ~$11–$13 per 1M tokens (depending on exact commit and reserved GPU tier).
- Embeddings: separate unit, typically priced per 1M embedding tokens/requests — see the attached sheet for a line item.

Next steps / asks from you: 
- Confirm average tokens/request and expected monthly token run-rate you want modeled for Q4.
- If procurement wants a 1- or 2-page SOW + invoice estimate for approvals, we can produce that (Marissa will kick off).

I attached the two files (spreadsheet + PDF) with the cost model and assumptions. Happy to jump on a short follow-up call to walk through the sheet.

Thanks,
Sean
Senior Account Exec | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
--
Attachment: acme-token-estimate.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)
Attachment: acme-cost-breakdown.pdf (pdf, 12KB)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Acme / Redwood pricing & token-volume next steps

Thanks Sean — quick clarifications: 

On Wed, Aug 12, 2026 at 9:15 AM Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com> wrote:
> Alex — great to speak this morning. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery: 
> 
> Summary of what we heard: 
> - Primary use: in-product assistant (search + summarization + short-form generation) across web and mobile.
> - Expected traffic: rough ballpark you shared of ~25M tokens/month initially, with growth to ~60M over 12 months.

To be precise: current pilot traffic is about 8M tokens/month (mostly read-only summaries), but assuming successful pilot we expect a conservative ramp to ~30M tokens/month within 3 months of GA. 12-month projection ~70M tokens/month.

Avg tokens per request: closer to 250 tokens/request (we typically do 50-token prompts + 200-token responses).

Budget: procurement told me they can stretch to $35k/mo if we can get close to $10–$12 per 1M tokens for committed pricing. Is that feasible with a 12-month commit and an annual invoice? Also can you break out embeddings cost — we will use embeddings for similarity search across content (estimated 500k embedding calls/month to start).

Can you include a line for a 12-month commitment at an annual invoice (no monthly invoices) and a 24-month tier if there are meaningful additional discounts? Procurement wants the line items spelled out for CFO review.

Alex
Alex Johnson
Director of Product, Acme Corp
alex.johnson@acme.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Acme / Redwood pricing & token-volume next steps

Alex — thanks for the precision, very helpful. I've updated the attached estimate with the 250 avg tokens/request and three commitment scenarios (monthly pay-as-you-go, 12-month annual prepaid commit, 24-month committed pricing). Highlights from the attached model: 

Assumptions used (see acme-cost-breakdown.pdf):
- Pilot start: 8M tokens/month (month 0).
- Ramp: 30M tokens/month by month 3, 70M tokens/month by month 12 (per your projection).
- Avg tokens/request: 250.
- Embeddings: 500k calls/month; we priced embeddings as a separate SKU in the sheet.
- Discounting: 12-month annual prepaid commit = ~15% off list; 24-month commit = ~22% off list.

Sample unit economics (published in the sheet):
- List hosted rate (no commit): $16.50 per 1M tokens.
- 12-month prepaid commit target: $11.50 per 1M tokens (this factors reserved capacity discounts + expected batching/caching savings).
- 24-month commit target: $10.20 per 1M tokens (higher discount for longer commit).

Example invoice snapshot (month 3 at 30M tokens):
- Token usage charge (30 * $11.50) = $345.0k per month (note: sheet shows per-1M and multiplies).
- Embeddings add-on (500k calls) = see embedding line (approx $2k–$5k depending on model).

I realize the raw monthly number can look large — the per-1M metric is the key number procurement will use for unit economics. If your procurement target is ~$10–$12 per 1M tokens on a 12-month invoice, the 12-month prepaid commit scenario in the attached file lands at ~$11.5/1M using the assumptions above. There are levers to reduce that (higher commit, reserved GPU tier, per-route throttling to smooth peaks).

Next steps I propose: 
- Marissa to draft a 1-page SOW + invoice estimate formatted for procurement/CFO (I cc'd her).
- If procurement confirms annual invoice and commit window (12 or 24 months), we'll produce a final committed pricing quote and a mutual action plan (MAP).
- Book a 30-min follow-up next week to walk procurement through the sheet — available Tue/Thu afternoons.

Let me know which commit term procurement prefers and whether embeddings should be included in the committed SKU or billed separately.

Thanks,
Sean
Senior Account Exec | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
--
Attachment: acme-token-estimate.xlsx (xlsx, 52KB)
Attachment: acme-cost-breakdown.pdf (pdf, 14KB)

Looping in procurement support items — I'll draft the 1-pager SOW and a clean invoice PDF formatted for CFO review. Plan: 
- Use the 12-month prepaid commit at $11.50/1M as the primary line, with a 24-month alternate at $10.20/1M.
- Add an embeddings add-on line with a clear per-1M/requests metric.

I'll have a draft SOW + invoice by EOD Friday and will upload the PDF to the Drive link Sean included.
